overview.location: Greater Hobby neighborhood, southeast Houston, Texas — about 7 miles southeast of downtown Houston. NOT George Bush Intercontinental (IAH), Houston's larger airport ~23 miles north of downtown.
overview.passengerVolume: 13.94 million passengers in 2025 (Wikipedia, citing Houston Airport System)
overview.distinction: Opened in June 1927 as a private landing field; renamed Houston Municipal (1937), Howard R. Hughes Airport (1938), Houston International (1954) and William P. Hobby Airport (1967) after the former Texas governor. Southwest Airlines' operating base — Southwest carried ~94.6% of HOU passengers (June 2025-May 2026). Southwest began international flights from the West Concourse on October 15, 2015; in February 2020 HOU became the first Texas airport with full biometric entry and exit for international passengers.
overview.gateNote: Wikipedia: Central Concourse 25 gates + West Concourse 5 gates (international-capable). A 7-gate West Concourse expansion is under construction (see construction2026). Verify gate counts on the fly2houston.com interactive map before quoting.
overview.nonstopDestinations: Domestic network dominated by Southwest, plus Southwest international service to Mexico, Central America and the Caribbean from the West Concourse (verify current destinations on fly2houston.com)
overview.internationalService: Southwest international flights from the West Concourse (Federal Inspection Services on site) since October 15, 2015.
overview.metroAccess: METRO 500 Downtown Direct was extended to Hobby on February 22, 2026 ($4.50 one-way, links HOU, downtown/George R. Brown Convention Center and IAH — verify current schedule). Local METRO buses stop at Curb Zone 3: routes 40, 50, 73 (connects to the Red Line rail) and 88 (Wikipedia — verify).
overview.terminalConnection: Single terminal; Central and West Concourses are connected airside. Red Garage and Blue Garage sit next to the terminal (walk). ecopark is served by a continuous shuttle (about every 10 minutes) to the terminal curb.

terminals.name: Main Terminal — Central Concourse and West Concourse
terminals.status: Active. Single terminal serving all airlines.
terminals.gates: 30 gates: Central Concourse (25) and West Concourse (5, international-capable). Verify airline-to-gate assignments on the fly2houston.com interactive map.
terminals.securityCheckpoints: TSA checkpoint hours not published in text on fly2houston.com/hou/security (live wait-time widget only) — verify
terminals.parking: Red Garage (valet on Level 2) and Blue Garage attached/adjacent; ecopark surface lot by shuttle
terminals.notes: CLEAR available Sunday-Friday 4:30 AM-8:00 PM and Saturday 4:30 AM-7:00 PM (fly2houston.com/hou/security). Southwest international arrivals clear customs in the West Concourse.

roads: Interstate 45 (Gulf Freeway) — main access from downtown Houston and Galveston
Loop 610 (South Loop) and Beltway 8 (Sam Houston Tollway) for regional access
transit: METRO 500 Downtown Direct (HOU-downtown-IAH, $4.50 one-way, since Feb 22, 2026 — verify schedule)
METRO local buses at Curb Zone 3: 40, 50, 73 (to Red Line), 88 (verify)

metro500.operator: METRO (Metropolitan Transit Authority of Harris County)
metro500.note: Links HOU with downtown (incl. George R. Brown Convention Center) and IAH; dedicated luggage space and Wi-Fi reported. Verify current timetable on ridemetro.org.

taxi.fareType: Zone/flat fares published by the airport (excluding gratuity)
taxi.pickup: Curb Zone 2 outside Baggage Claim/Arrivals Level — follow 'Ground Transportation' then 'Taxis' signs
taxi.surcharges: $1.25 departure fee; $1.00 late-night surcharge 8:00 PM-6:00 AM; seniors 10% discount

rideshare.pickupLocation: Curb Zone 5 outside Baggage Claim/Arrivals Level — exit through the door nearest Baggage Claim Carousel 4 and follow 'Ride App' signs

rentalCars.pickup: Not verified — fly2houston.com rental-car page did not load (404) on 2026-10-16. Verify location and companies before quoting.
rentalCars.note: Do not state a rental car facility location until verified.

groundTransportation.busPort: METRO local buses at Curb Zone 3 (Wikipedia — verify).
groundTransportation.hotelShuttles: Sellable hotel lots sit 1.1-1.6 miles from HOU along Airport Blvd, Monroe Rd and the Gulf Freeway (I-45). DoubleTree, Marriott South and Hobby Airport Parking run their own 24/7 shuttles; Hampton Inn uses a complimentary Lyft booked through the hotel 24 hours ahead. Hotel/shuttle pickup curb zone at HOU not verified.

parkingRates: On-airport (fly2houston.com, tax included, verified 2026-10-16): Red/Blue terminal garages $25/day max ($1 for 0-10 min, $5 for 11 min-1 hr, $2.50 each additional 30 min), ecopark $10/day (16 min-24 hrs; continuous shuttle), Valet $30 per 24 hrs (Red Garage Level 2). Garages switch to pre-booked reservations only once 85% full. Off-site hotel/shuttle lots bookable on Triply from ~$4.73/day.

onAirportParking.operator: SP+ (SP+ GLOBAL / IMS) for the Houston Airport System — 281-233-1786 (parking info), 281-233-1729 (Parking Plus / customer service)

terminalGarages.name: Terminal Garages (Red Garage and Blue Garage)
terminalGarages.features: Adjacent to the terminal; Parking Guidance System with overhead lights to open spaces. Once garage capacity reaches 85%, only pre-booked reservations may park. Oversized vehicles allowed if under 6'7" height; taller ADA vehicles use Red Garage Level 1 (garage rates) or ecopark.

ecopark.name: ecopark (economy surface lot)

rates.0-15 minutes: listed without a price on the rate page (verify)

ecopark.connection: Uncovered lot; shuttle runs continuously about every 10 minutes and drops at the terminal curb (fly2houston.com HOU parking tips page). Shuttle hours not published — verify.
ecopark.features: Cheapest on-airport option. Airport recommends a reservation at ecopark. Write down the facility and shelter letter / row number when you park. EV charging (Blink) at ecopark per the EV page.

valetParking.name: HOU Valet Parking
valetParking.location: Second level of the Red Garage, off the departures ramp
valetParking.features: Covered spaces, advance online reservations, car wash available, free bottle of water. Valet booth 713-845-6698.

cellPhoneLot.name: Cell Phone Lot (free)
cellPhoneLot.location: Not verified on fly2houston.com (page 404 on 2026-10-16). Third-party sources place it on the airport access road off Airport Blvd — verify before quoting.

locations: Blue Garage Level 2, Row D for self-parkers and Red Garage Level 2 for valet (fly2houston.com HOU parking tips page)
evCharging.network: Blink — Blink InCard or smartphone QR guest code; support +1-888-998-2546
evCharging.cost: Charging sessions free; standard parking rate applies
evCharging.note: The two official pages disagree on location — verify before quoting a specific spot.

parkingPlusProgram.name: Parking Plus (free frequent parking program, IAH + HOU)
parkingPlusProgram.earning: Points at all terminal garages and ecopark lots; credited automatically at end of stay; card on file charged on exit
parkingPlusProgram.redemption: Free days redeemed online; redemption does not reserve a space; must enter on the redeemed date

veteranParking.summary: Complimentary parking for veterans with an active Texas Veteran specialty plate, registration receipt in the veteran's name and the veteran in the car at exit: up to 60 consecutive days at HOU ecopark OR up to 5 consecutive days in a garage. Not valid for valet or with an online reservation (drive-up program). New reservation-based option for pre-qualified veterans begins November 2, 2026 (reservation fee waived).
veteranParking.outOfState: 'OUT OF STATE - Disabled Veteran' appears in the approved plate list

onAirportParking.maxStay: Up to 60 days in any garage or ecopark without notice; longer stays call SP+ at 281-233-1786
onAirportParking.paymentMethods: Cashless. Debit, Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Apple Pay, Google Pay. Cash-to-card machine available.
onAirportParking.lostTicket: Not published on fly2houston.com — verify with SP+ (281-233-1786). Entry is by inserting the same card in and out (cashless entry).
onAirportParking.reservations: Online reservations via fly2houston.com 'Book your parking'; prepaid reservations cancellable up to 3 hours before check-in (refund less convenience fee); arrive within 3 hours of the booked check-in time (SP+ terms).
onAirportParking.garageServiceAreas: Red and Blue Garages → main terminal (walk). ecopark → terminal curb by shuttle.
onAirportParking.arrivalTip: Garages go reservation-only at 85% capacity — book ahead on busy dates or use an off-site lot.

parkingLots.name: DoubleTree Houston Hobby Airport
parkingLots.sampleQuote: $40.77 total for Nov 2-9, 2026 (8 billing days: $36.00 subtotal + $1.80 fees + $2.97 tax), before Triply service fee
parkingLots.parkingType: Gated hotel lot with full in/out privileges
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: 24/7 every 15 minutes. Visit the front desk first for a validation code, then scan the on-site QR code to register the vehicle. Return: call 713-645-3000 after collecting luggage.
parkingLots.overview: DoubleTree on Airport Blvd about a 5-minute drive from HOU — the lowest sellable rate at Hobby, gated lot with full in/out privileges and a complimentary shuttle that also runs within a three-mile radius.
parkingLots.notes: Cheapest at HOU on 2026-10-16 (same $4.73/day across Nov 2-9, 9-16 and 16-23 searches). All vehicles must be registered via QR code after front-desk validation. Badge 'lowest_total' on search.

parkingLots.name: Houston Hobby Marriott South
parkingLots.sampleQuote: $41.58 total for Nov 2-9, 2026 (8 billing days: $39.60 subtotal + $1.98 fees, $0 tax), before Triply service fee
amenities: Oversized Vehicles Accepted (full-size vans, pickups, large SUVs at no extra charge)
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: 24/7, every 30 minutes on the hour and half-hour. Check in at the front desk for parking instructions. Return: call (713) 943-7979.
parkingLots.overview: Houston Marriott South on the Gulf Freeway (I-45), about 5 minutes from HOU, with a 24/7 half-hourly shuttle, on-site EV charging and no surcharge for full-size vans, pickups or large SUVs.
parkingLots.notes: Daily-rate lot (minimum 1 booking day). Hotel offers room-and-parking packages directly. Arrive before the 2-hour pre-flight window.

parkingLots.name: Hobby Airport Parking
parkingLots.sampleQuote: $45.93 total for Nov 2-9, 2026 (8 billing days: $39.60 subtotal + $2.98 fees + $3.35 tax), before Triply service fee
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: 24/7, every 15 minutes on a set schedule (accessible shuttle per listing). Check in at the front desk for a validation code and register via QR code (plate, phone, stay length, code). If the shuttle hasn't come within 20 minutes, call the shuttle directly.
parkingLots.overview: Independent parking lot on Monroe Rd near HOU with round-the-clock camera surveillance and a scheduled 24/7 shuttle every 15 minutes.
parkingLots.notes: Listing description says 'half a mile' from HOU but the search result distance is 1.4 mi — use 1.4 mi. Listing says 'hotel front desk' check-in; confirm what the check-in point is before describing it in detail.

parkingLots.name: Hampton Inn Houston Hobby Airport
parkingLots.sampleQuote: $59.32 total for Nov 2-9, 2026 (8 billing days: $47.60 subtotal + $7.38 fees + $4.34 tax), before Triply service fee
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: Complimentary Lyft rideshare (partnered), available 24/7 — must be booked through the hotel at least 24 hours in advance by calling 713-641-6400. Travelers who book outside normal hours must arrange their own transport. Return: call 713-641-6400 and go to the HOU rideshare pickup area (Curb Zone 5).
parkingLots.overview: Hampton Inn about a 3-minute drive (one mile) from HOU, right off I-45, with a complimentary Lyft transfer instead of a hotel shuttle; parkers get restroom and Wi-Fi access.
parkingLots.notes: NOT a shuttle lot — the transfer is a hotel-booked Lyft that needs 24 hours' notice. Flag this clearly in every article.

shuttleInfo: On-airport: ecopark shuttle runs continuously about every 10 minutes to the terminal curb (hours not published — verify); Red and Blue Garages are walk-in. Off-site: DoubleTree (24/7 every 15 min) and Hobby Airport Parking (24/7 every 15 min) run the most frequent shuttles; Marriott South runs 24/7 every 30 minutes; Hampton Inn uses a complimentary Lyft booked 24 hours ahead.
distanceFromCity: About 7 miles southeast of downtown Houston via I-45 (Gulf Freeway). METRO 500 Downtown Direct links HOU and downtown ($4.50).

keyDistances.toDowntownHouston: ~7 miles via I-45; taxi flat $29; METRO 500 $4.50
keyDistances.competitiveAdvantage: HOU's own ecopark is only $10/day, so off-site savings vs ecopark are modest (~$3-5/day). The big gap is vs the Red/Blue garages ($25/day) and valet ($30/day), and the fact that garages go reservation-only at 85% capacity.

construction2026.status: West Concourse expansion under construction — 7 new gates; announced 2022 at $250M, cost rose to $470M at construction start in November 2024; completion scheduled for 2027 (Wikipedia — verify).
construction2026.travelImpact: No parking closures verified for 2026. Check fly2houston.com/hou/redevelopment before each trip.

peakTravelTimes.seasonalPeak: Spring break, summer, Thanksgiving, Christmas/New Year; Houston Livestock Show & Rodeo (Feb-Mar) and big NRG Park events add volume.

arrivalRecommendation.holidays: Book parking ahead — garages go reservation-only at 85% capacity

weatherPatterns.climate: Humid subtropical — hot, humid summers, mild winters, heavy rain.
weatherPatterns.commonDisruptions: Summer thunderstorms, tropical storms and hurricanes (June-November), street flooding during heavy rain; occasional winter freezes.
weatherPatterns.note: Of the sellable lots, none advertises covered parking; valet (Red Garage) is the only covered option verified.

parkSleepFly.description: Three sellable HOU lots are hotels, so travelers can book a room directly with the hotel and park through Triply — or check the hotel's own room-and-parking package (Marriott South offers them). Package terms not verified.

savingsComparison.scenario: 7-night trip, Nov 2-9, 2026 (8 billing days on Triply for 10 AM drop-off / 2 PM pick-up)
savingsComparison.triplyFeeNote: Off-site figures are lot totals before Triply's service fee, added at checkout.
savingsComparison.billingDayNote: On-airport comparison assumes 8 charged 24-hour periods to match the Triply 8-day quote; airport billing by 24-hour block may differ — verify.

metro500RoundTrip.note: Cheapest if you live near a 500 stop downtown.

savingsComparison.keyDifference: Off-site lots save ~$140-160 vs the HOU garages ($25/day) and ~$180-200 vs valet, but only ~$20-40 per week vs ecopark ($10/day). The HOU pitch is 'skip the $25 garage and the 85%-full reservation-only rule' and 'shuttle every 15 minutes' — not 'beat ecopark by a mile'.

uniqueFeatures.southwestBase: Southwest carries ~95% of HOU passengers — most Hobby parkers are Southwest flyers.
uniqueFeatures.notIAH: Houston has two commercial airports. HOU (Hobby) is 7 miles southeast of downtown; IAH (Bush Intercontinental) is ~23 miles north. Searchers mix them up — say which airport early.
uniqueFeatures.garageReservationRule: HOU garages accept only pre-booked reservations once 85% full.
uniqueFeatures.texasVeteranParking: Free parking for qualifying Texas Veteran plates: 60 days at ecopark or 5 days in a garage.
uniqueFeatures.biometricFirst: First Texas airport with full biometric entry/exit for international passengers (Feb 2020).
uniqueFeatures.historicTerminal: The 1940 Art Deco terminal now houses the 1940 Air Terminal Museum (verify before quoting).
